estimates.assumptions: 400g raw minced beef (80/20 lean-fat ratio assumed); all used in 4 patties
2 tbs olive oil; assumes all 28g used for frying the patties
2 standard sesame seed burger buns (~70g each including top, middle, bottom layers); all used
1 medium onion (~110g) chopped; full amount used in assembly
1/4 head iceberg lettuce (~75g) shredded; full amount used
2 slices American-style cheese (~20g each); full amount used
2 large dill pickles (~50g each drained); full amount sliced and used
1 cup mayonnaise (full 220g; all used in Big Mac sauce)
2 tsp white wine vinegar (~10g); all used in sauce
Pinch of pepper (~0.5g); modest quantity used in sauce
2 tsp mustard (~10g); all used in sauce
1.5 tsp onion salt (~9g); modest quantity used in sauce
1.5 tsp garlic powder (~4.5g); all used in sauce
0.5 tsp paprika (~1.5g); all used in sauce
